ul.li: Patient will monitor and record weight daily to detect early signs of fluid retention.
Patient will adhere to a sodium-restricted diet as recommended to reduce fluid overload.
Patient will limit daily fluid intake as recommended to prevent fluid overload.
Patient will take prescribed heart failure medications as directed.
Patient will recognize and promptly report symptoms of heart failure exacerbation such as increased shortness of breath, swelling, or rapid weight gain.
Patient will monitor blood pressure regularly and report significant changes.
Patient will maintain hemoglobin A1c within individualized target range to optimize diabetes control.
